name: @river/mobile
description: River for Android (and later iOS): the desktop's UI and client core in a Capacitor app, with libsignal, SQLCipher and the Android Keystore underneath.

scripts.build: vite build -c vite.core.config.ts && vite build -c vite.ui.config.ts
scripts.sync: npm run build && cap sync android && node -e "require('node:fs').cpSync('dist/core','android/app/src/main/assets/core',{recursive:true})"
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build && node -e "require('node:fs').cpSync('dist/core','ios/RiverNative/core',{recursive:true})" && cap sync ios
